items.title: Cosimo Matassa Interview, 1993-11-01
items.q: Interviewer mentions Mac Rabinac did material for Rex; Interviewee responds generally about recordings and mentions 'Max' (likely a mishearing of Mac or a different person) finishing a record with Seth, but does not explicitly describe a personal or professional relationship with Mac Rabinac.

ctx.x: She's a good writer. Never did click on anything.

Yeah, because I know I don't have it here. I mean, Mac Rabinac said that he did, he says, at least an album for you, for Rex. There's at least, so, I mean, there were two, there's only one release, which is. Yeah, Lord of the Day. So, but he says he must have done at least an album's worth of material for you. He did a lot of stuff.
Where would you see somebody with one record? There probably was at least two others.
